title: IT Professional | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: IT Professional. Category: Networking. Duration: 3 months. Description: A comprehensive program covering a range of IT topics to provide a strong foundation for entry-level IT industry positions. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
